intro: Across 38 articles published between 12 April and 21 October 2026, ZCyberNews tracked credential-theft activity linked to AccountDumpling, APT41, and Bluekit. Coverage cites CVE-2021-47928 (CVSS 8.2), CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, CVE-2025-55182, and CVE-2025-9501. The affected sectors were technology, software development, cloud services, financial services, and government, with reporting spanning Global, Europe, North america, Bangladesh, and Florida. Of the tagged stories, 28 were rated high severity, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 1 informational.
